name: Feirun
source:
A masochistic martial artist who is obsessed with increasing levels of physical training. However the stronger she gets, the fewer enemy attacks she suffers which leavers her conflicted as her masochistic tendencies are thwarted with the decreasing encounters with pain and injury.

She's extremely frank with regards to physical relationships with the opposite sex. She priorities mutual pleasure above all else and enjoys vigorous sexual activity between assertive partners.

On the other hand, she's not good with furtive sex acts nor with sex play which targets her sense of shame.

[Spoiler] Feirun was trained from a young age in martial arts by her father, who was so extreme in his methods he handed a dildo to her in order to break her hymen as it was an impediment to training. She was constantly forced to become stronger after losing fights in her dojo, until she progressed so far that no one in her village could fight her. Forced to leave the village in search of new challenges and to discover her personal limits, she reaches Dantor and promptly loses to Edgar when she impetuously attacks him. She joints the guild both to get stronger practising with Edgar (despite his physical handicap) and to repay the damage to the public house when she fought Edgar.

She possesses a strong sense of righteousness, but her propensity to move first and think later gets her into fights more often than not. Each time she loses to Edgar in their practice duels, she challenges him at night in sex battles (and loses each time). [/Spoiler]
